channel.description: Latest articles from The American Mind (americanmind.org)

item.title: Down with the Establishment
item.description: Their ideas have gotten only more musty as time has gone on, and they are the ones who have become the political aberration, not Trump.

item.title: The Cuban Mirage: A Revolution Exposed
item.description: Irving Louis Horowitz told the truth about Fidel Castro and Cuban tyranny for many decades when it was fashionable to lie with impunity.

item.title: What the Hell Happened to DOGE?
item.description: The recent revelation of hundreds of millions of dollars in Medicaid fraud in Minnesota shows the importance of its mission.

item.title: Does the Right Have a Woman Problem? | The Roundtable Ep. 309
item.description: A buzzy new essay at New York Mag announces that some women have grown disgruntled at the MAGA movement and by their treatment from some on the New Right. Now their criticisms are being used to publicly discredit conservatism, wholesale. The concerns are real, but need to be addressed in-house—before they become oppo fodder. item.title: The Case Against “Principled Conservatism”
item.description: Their pristine—and presently useless—“principles" are of no help to Trump's project to restore and advance American power.

item.title: Playing the Wrong Game
item.description: Leftists are targeting billionaires in California and elsewhere because they want to seize the power of that wealth for themselves.

item.title: The Second Sex and the Radicalism of Modern Feminism
item.description: Our increasingly sexless/genderless world is palpably and radically out of touch with many undeniable facts of reality.

item.title: The LGBTQ Tidal Wave Was Never About a Social Contagion
item.description: Radicals aim to change the distribution of privilege from historically favored groups to historically disfavored ones.

item.title: The Case Against Federal Reserve Independence
item.description: Economic stability is obviously desirable, but we cannot purchase it at the cost of the principle of self-government.

item.title: The Age of America
item.description: Americans need to recover a sense of their country as an era-defining project, forward-looking but steeped in traditions of faith and law.
